steps.title: Prepare 5× cleavage reaction buffer
steps.instruction: Weigh 2.5 g glycerol into a 15 mL conical tube, add 1.0 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 5.0 mL 1 M KCl, 0.25 mL 1 M MgCl₂, and 0.5 mL freshly prepared 0.1 M DTT (15.5 mg DTT dissolved in 1 mL water). Add ultrapure water to a final volume of 10 mL, mix, store without DTT at 4 °C and use within 3 months.

steps.title: Prepare Ni‑affinity lysis buffer
steps.instruction: In 1 L of ultrapure water add 7.88 g Tris‑HCl (50 mM, pH 7.5), 29.22 g NaCl (500 mM), 0.143 g TCEP (0.5 mM), and 0.681 g Imidazole (10 mM). Adjust pH if needed, bring volume to 1 L.

steps.title: Prepare Ni‑affinity elution buffer
steps.instruction: In 1 L of ultrapure water add 7.88 g Tris‑HCl (50 mM, pH 7.5), 29.22 g NaCl (500 mM), 0.143 g TCEP (0.5 mM), and 17.02 g Imidazole (250 mM). Adjust pH, bring to 1 L.

steps.title: Prepare heparin buffer A
steps.instruction: In 1 L of ultrapure water add 3.15 g Tris‑HCl (20 mM, pH 7.5), 8.77 g NaCl (150 mM), and 0.287 g TCEP (1 mM). Adjust pH, bring to 1 L.

steps.title: Prepare heparin buffer B
steps.instruction: In 1 L of ultrapure water add 3.15 g Tris‑HCl (20 mM, pH 7.5), 75.97 g NaCl (1.3 M), and 0.287 g TCEP (1 mM). Adjust pH, bring to 1 L.

steps.title: Prepare TEV cleavage buffer
steps.instruction: In 950 mL ultrapure water add 3.15 g Tris‑HCl (20 mM, pH 7.5), 14.61 g NaCl (250 mM), 0.287 g TCEP (1 mM), and 50 mL glycerol (5 % v/v). Adjust pH, bring to 1 L total volume.

steps.title: Prepare SEC chromatography buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare exactly as TEV cleavage buffer (Tris‑HCl 20 mM, NaCl 250 mM, TCEP 1 mM, glycerol 5 % v/v) in 950 mL water then bring to 1 L.

steps.title: Prepare Cas9 storage buffer
steps.instruction: In 950 mL ultrapure water add 4.76 g HEPES (20 mM, pH 7.5), 8.77 g NaCl (150 mM), 0.287 g TCEP (1 mM), and 50 mL glycerol (5 % v/v). Adjust pH, bring to 1 L.

steps.title: Extract mouse genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL ultrapure water, 10 µL Xpert directXtract buffer A, and 5 µL buffer B to a 0.2 mL PCR tube containing 1–2 mm ear‑punch tissue (total 50 µL lysis solution). Incubate 37 °C 10 min, then 95 °C 10 min, cool to room temperature, centrifuge 14,000–16,000 × g 1 min, transfer 35 µL cleared supernatant to a new tube. Store at –20 °C (≥3 months).

steps.title: Amplify target region by PCR
steps.instruction: Set up a 20 µL PCR master mix per reaction: 8 µL ultrapure water, 10 µL DreamTaq 2×, 0.5 µL 10 µM Tnnt2‑F primer, 0.5 µL 10 µM Tnnt2‑R primer, 1 µL genomic DNA lysate. Prepare master mix for 32 reactions, aliquot into 8‑tube strips. Run program: 95 °C 2 min; 35 cycles – 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 30 s (adjust 55–62 °C if needed), 72 °C 60 s; 72 °C 10 min; 4 °C hold. Combine 24 reactions (640 µL total) and reserve 3 µL for a 1 % agarose gel check.

steps.title: Purify PCR product and quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1,280 µL NTI binding buffer to the 640 µL pooled PCR product, mix, load evenly onto two NucleoSpin columns. Wash three times with 700 µL NT3 buffer. Elute twice with 50 µL 5 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.5 per column (total 100 µL). Measure concentration with Nanodrop (expected 120–160 ng/µL, A260/280 ≈ 1.85–1.90). Store DNA substrate at –20 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and lyse Cas9‑expressing cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the harvested BL21(DE3) cell pellet in 30 mL Geo Cas9 Ni‑affinity lysis buffer plus 1 mL 100 mM PMSF. Sonicate on ice: 4 × pulse, 5 s on/5 s off, 2 min 30 s total per cycle, amplitude 60 %. Centrifuge 15,500 rpm (≈29,070 × g) 30 min, collect supernatant (keep 15 µL for SDS‑PAGE).

steps.title: Purify Cas9 via Ni‑NTA chromatography
steps.instruction: Connect FPLC line A to lysis buffer (Recipe 2) and line B to elution buffer (Recipe 3). Zero UV baseline with lysis buffer. Equilibrate Ni‑NTA cartridge with 2 × column volume lysis buffer (hand‑flush or syringe). Load supernatant onto column (hand‑flow preferred). Wash column with 70 mL lysis buffer. Elute with a linear 0 %–100 % gradient of elution buffer over 150 mL, collecting 5 mL fractions. Verify Cas9 presence by SDS‑PAGE. Buffer‑exchange eluted fractions into heparin buffer A using a 10 kDa Amicon spin concentrator (or overnight dialysis at 4 °C). Concentrate to a volume suitable for a 10 mL FPLC loop.

steps.title: Exchange buffer and concentrate Ni‑purified Cas9
steps.instruction: Using a 10 kDa MWCO Amicon spin filter, dilute the Ni‑NTA eluate with heparin buffer A, reconcentrate, and repeat until the sample is fully in buffer A. Adjust final volume to ~10 mL for injection onto the heparin column.

steps.title: Purify Cas9 on heparin column and digest
steps.instruction: Load ~10 mL of Cas9 in buffer A onto the heparin column via a 10 mL injection loop (pre‑equilibrate loop with 3 mL buffer A, then run 20 mL buffer A through loop). Set flow rate to 5 mL/min, zero UV detector on buffer A. Wash column with ~70 mL buffer A. Elute with a 0 %–100 % gradient of buffer B over 150 mL, collecting 1 mL fractions. Identify Cas9‑containing fractions by SDS‑PAGE. Dialyze each selected fraction together with 1 mL 100 µM TEV protease against 2 L TEV cleavage buffer (Recipe 6) overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dialyze Cas9 with TEV protease
steps.instruction: After overnight dialysis, retrieve protein solution, keep 15 µL for SDS‑PAGE verification, then buffer‑exchange into size‑exclusion chromatography buffer (Recipe 7) using a 10 kDa Amicon concentrator. Concentrate to 10 mL.

steps.title: Perform size‑exclusion chromatography of Cas9
steps.instruction: Equilibrate a HiLoad 26/600 Superdex 200 column with 330 mL SEC buffer at 2.6 mL/min on the FPLC. Load the 10 mL Cas9 sample via the injection loop, run at 2.6 mL/min, collect 2 mL fractions. Assess purity by SDS‑PAGE; if impurities remain, repeat Ni‑NTA step. Pool pure fractions, buffer‑exchange into storage buffer (Recipe 8), and concentrate to 1.5 mL aliquots using a 10 kDa Amicon filter.

steps.title: Aliquot and store purified Cas9
steps.instruction: Flash‑freeze each 1.5 mL aliquot in liquid nitrogen, store at –80 °C. Typical final concentration is 50–100 µM in ~5 mL total volume.

steps.title: Resuspend and quantify sgRNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the lyophilized 5 nmol custom CRISPR RNA in 50 µL (for 100 µM stock) or 100 µL (for 50 µM stock) ultrapure water as indicated on the tube. Measure concentration with a Nanodrop Lite, aliquot 5 µL, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Assemble Cas9‑sgRNA ribonucleoprotein complex
steps.instruction: On ice in a 200 µL PCR tube add 2.15 µL 14 µM Geo Cas9, 1.05 µL 28.5 µM sgRNA, and 6.80 µL nuclease‑free water (or 1× reaction buffer) to reach a 3 µM RNP complex (total 10 µL). Invert, briefly spin, incubate at 37 °C or 60 °C for 10 min, then keep on ice.

steps.title: Set up in‑vitro cleavage reactions
steps.instruction: For each reaction (total 10 µL) combine according to Table 2: water, 5× cleavage buffer, DNA substrate (0.5 µM, ~150 ng), and RNP to achieve the desired RNP concentration (0.1–0.9 µM). A convenient master mix is 6.5 µL 0.5 µM DNA substrate + 13 µL 5× buffer; add 3 µL of this mix to each tube, then add the appropriate volume of RNP and water. Prepare reactions on ice in an 8‑tube strip, invert, spin briefly.

steps.title: Incubate cleavage reactions and terminate
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm the thermocycler to the chosen cleavage temperature (e.g., 37 °C). Set lid temperature 5 °C higher than reaction temperature. Place the strip in the thermocycler, incubate 30 min. After incubation, chill on ice, add 1 µL 20 mg/mL proteinase K to each tube, incubate 56 °C 10 min. Cool on ice, then add 2 µL 6× DNA loading buffer.

steps.title: Prepare agarose gel for analysis
steps.instruction: Make a 2 % agarose gel in 1× TAE buffer, add GelRed® (10,000× stock) to the molten agarose as per manufacturer’s instructions. Allow gel to solidify.

steps.title: Run gel, image, and analyze bands
steps.instruction: Load 6 µL of each cleavage reaction (mixed with loading buffer) into the gel wells. Run at 300 mA for ~25 min. Image the gel with a UVP gel imaging system, save as a .TIF file, and quantify band intensities using ImageJ.
